title: 2.02 / Spectrum Logo Clear Space
slide_intent: Protect space around a mark so nearby content does not obscure its identity.
strategic_value: A repeatable exclusion zone can keep Spectrum recognizable across crowded retail placements.
demonstration: A boxed logo diagram derives the surrounding x unit from the counter of the letter p. A note allows reduced space in special sponsorship circumstances.
practical_value: Measure the clear area with the logo’s own geometry and identify when a documented exception applies.

content_islands.name: Heading and rule
content_islands.spec: Place the title upper left, explanatory paragraph in the upper center and exception note upper right.

content_islands.name: Clear-space diagram
content_islands.spec: Center the logo inside nested guide rectangles and connect the p counter to the x-unit note with a cyan leader.

ingredient.name: Logo clear space
ingredient.role: Separate the mark from neighboring information.
ingredient.application: Keep at least the illustrated x space, derived from the negative space of the p, around the logo.
ingredient.scope: TV, print and online use in this guide. Sponsorship layouts can reduce spacing under special circumstances to preserve impact.
